content:
I don't have a tool that can list or close browser tabs — my available tools let me navigate, read, and interact with the page content of the current tab (and open new background tabs for reference), but there's no "close tab" or "list all open tabs" function available to me.

To close all your other tabs except this one, you'd need to do it manually — for example, right-click this tab and choose "Close other tabs" (available in Chrome, Edge, and most Chromium-based browsers), or use the keyboard/tab-switcher UI directly.
